command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_02','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','FW_01','FW_02','SZ_AR'); `$results=foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$cmd='display current-configuration'; `$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_07/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1; `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2; Compare-Object -ReferenceObject (`$a.output -split '\r?\n') -DifferenceObject (`$b.output -split '\r?\n') | Select-Object InputObject,SideIndicator }; `$results | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5"
